title: Oracle Essbase Session
description: An active user session on the Oracle Essbase server. Sessions track connected users, their active application and database context, and any currently running requests such as calculations or data loads.

userId.description: User name of the logged-in user who owns this session.

sessionId.description: Unique numeric session identifier assigned by the server.

loginTimeInSeconds.description: Number of seconds elapsed since the user logged in and the session began.

application.description: Name of the application the user is currently connected to, if any.

database.description: Name of the database the user is currently connected to, if any.

dbConnectTimeInSeconds.description: Number of seconds elapsed since the user connected to the active database.

request.description: Type of the currently active request, such as calculation, data load, or restructure.

requestTimeInSeconds.description: Number of seconds the currently active request has been running.

connectionSource.description: Hostname or URL of the service from which the user connected.

requestState.description: Current status of the active request.
